handoff: Review approve: B11/AC1, AC2 proven by watch-version.test.ts at S1; unit, integration, typecheck green; two nits only (human-mode notify error line, no human-line test).

findings.title: A failed notification logs JSON even under --human
findings.detail:
pausedOnVersion logs JSON.stringify({error}) when a notifier throws, whatever the output mode; in --human mode every other line is plain text.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Pass `human` in and log a plain line, as the tick-failure path does.

findings.title: No test pins the --human 'tick skipped' line or the skipped_version summary text
findings.detail:
The acceptance criteria cover only the JSON mode, so this is not required.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optionally add a humanSummary assertion that includes skipped_version.
